newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Police seize mines from Kuwait travel agency.
newsitem.headline: Police seize mines from Kuwait travel agency.

text.p: Kuwait's police seized 28 military-issue mines and a bomb from the office of a travel agency, the Interior Ministry said on Wednesday.
Police "have received a report about 28 anti-tank and anti-personnel mines ... found in a Fahaheel commercial store belonging to a travel agency," a ministry statement said.
The statement said a bomb and three detonators were among the weapons found. It did not give further details. Fahaheel is a town some 30 km south of Kuwait City.
Diplomats said Kuwait was concerned that weapons kept by residents could be smuggled to neighbouring countries for what they described as potential terrorist attacks.
Thousands of weapons were left by Iraq's 1990-91 occupation troops after the 1991 Gulf War that ended the seven-month occupation.
